ci: paired Student-t 95% across independent seeds; contiguous-block bootstrap for NLL

training.data: WikiText-2 official splits; fixed GPT-2 tokenizer

main.tail_schedule: ramp from zero at step 300 to 0.003 per successful update at step 600
main.selection: common recipe primary; bounded LR pilots 1e-4/3e-4 and rank 4/8, tail 0/0.0003/0.003 on validation; no test-based selection

pretrained.eval: all WikiText-2 test tokens in nonoverlapping 512-token blocks; first target of each block excluded; identical protocol baseline/compressed
pretrained.selection: bounded layer pilot on validation; selected full-model codecs evaluated on test after fresh-process reload; reconstructed dense fallback labeled explicitly

runtime.scope: exact serialized payload; dense reconstruction reference and factorized core+packed residual CUDA kernel

mechanism.metric: actual update/gradient row/null norms, loss, fixed-bin entropy; no universal entropy inference

streaming.protocol: strict HTTP 206 and Content-Range; immutable source revision; complete tensors; archive coverage/reload/resume; increasing source count

distributed.single_gpu: unequal sharded-gradient and optimizer-update equality, measured payload and compressor costs
distributed.multi_gpu: requires distinct GPU devices; otherwise blocked
